text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there are even more of 'em now?!
Dammit, pimples are the worst!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Tch, how to cure it is...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
""Early to bed and early to rise will fix your daily rhythm"?
...Hmm..."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Wait! Go to bed even earlier than I already do?! How am I supposed to manage that?!

Espoir City was fretting over
a pimple that had suddenly popped up.
